title: Which README invariants fail?

evidence.I2: `service/invoice_service.py:get_invoice` only checks authentication and then calls `invoice_repo.get_by_id(invoice_id)` with no tenant filter. `service/invoice_service.py:admin_export_invoices` also returns `invoice_repo.export_all()` across tenants, so invoice reads are not tenant-scoped.
evidence.I3: `service/payment_service.py:handle_payment_webhook` performs `db.put("payments", ...)`, inserts `OrderPaid`, and calls `order_service.mark_paid(...)` before `_mark_processed(webhook_id)`. The dedupe marker is written last, so a concurrent duplicate or a retry after a mid-handler failure can replay the side effects and emit another `OrderPaid`.
